description: Estimate what a job will cost in credits BEFORE submitting it, and whether the connected account can afford it right now. Spends nothing. Pass the job (generate_music, render_midi, cover_song, separate_stems, transcribe, audio_to_session, convert_project, bounce_session, analyze_song, detect_chords, beat_grid, analyze_midi) and the same args you would give the job tool (duration_seconds, models, instruments; for render_midi: notes + bpm or duration_seconds, voice_split / voices, takes — takes are free, voices cost one batch per ~6). The estimate follows the planes' own price table; the gate is authoritative and a refusal names the exact price.

args.description: The arguments you intend to pass to the job tool; only the price-relevant ones matter.

job.description: Which job to price (a doseedo_ tool name or recipe verb is accepted too).

name: doseedo_quote
